name.description: Name of the form (e.g. 'login', 'signup-form', 'profile'). Used for file, class, and selector names.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names. Common names (email, password, phone, …) auto-pick the right preset; the rest become text inputs. Always includes a submit button at the end.

path.description: Directory under the project root to generate the component in.
